questions.q: A patient with COPD (Chronic Obstructive Pulmonary Disease) reports early satiety and fatigue while eating. Which dietary strategy is best?
options: Drinking large amounts of fluid with meals.
questions.explain: COPD patients often struggle to breathe while eating. Large meals increase diaphragm pressure. Small, frequent, calorie-dense meals reduce the work of eating and breathing. Fluids should be taken between meals to avoid fullness.
